title: ValidationReport
description: Blueprint v3.1 §4.3: validation runs schema, dimensions, graph connectivity, component/reference compatibility, conditional classification, capability checks, then task-specific structural analysis. A report is a result tied to a revision and a task, not an editable badge. Matching and Dulmage-Mendelsohn decomposition give structural counts; they do not prove nonlinear feasibility or numerical nonsingularity, so `structural_counts` may be null with a stated reason (in P01 it always is: no structural analysis exists before T01). `provenance.produced_by` says what produced the report, so a hand-authored expectation can never be mistaken for a validator's verdict.

status.description: DRAFT revisions may be incomplete or under-specified; READY_FOR_SIMULATION requires an appropriately closed system after fixed-variable elimination.

implicated_objects.description: Ids of the objects the check names. A structural conflict names every object in the conflict; it does not claim to be a unique minimal conflict set unless the evidence class says so.

evidence_class.description: Blueprint §4.3: additional rank or conflict searches must label which of these they are.

structural_counts_absent_reason.description: Required whenever structural_counts is null. Silence about a missing count is not permitted.

produced_by.description: The validator implementation and version, or an explicit statement that the document is a hand-authored expectation and no validator ran.
